sources.title: The Lattice K12
sources.supports: Authoritative catalogue metadata: rank 12, determinant 729, minimum 4, kissing number 756, integral and 3-modular.
sources.does_not_support: No Conway-99 endpoint, direct-sum non-realizability, block allocation, or logarithmic obstruction.

sources.title: The Lattice LAMBDA(F)
sources.supports: Authoritative catalogue metadata: rank 32, determinant 1, minimum 4, kissing number 146880, and unimodularity; also provides provenance references.
sources.does_not_support: No direct sum with K12 and no Wave-29 endpoint exclusion.

sources.title: The Coxeter-Todd lattice, the Mitchell group, and related sphere packings
sources.venue: Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society 93, 421-440
sources.supports: Primary construction and study of the Coxeter-Todd lattice and its related packings.
sources.does_not_support: No searched metadata indicated the exact rank-44 direct-sum endpoint result.

sources.title: Über ganzzahlige unimodulare euklidische Gitter
sources.venue: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik 398, 144-168
sources.supports: Primary provenance for integral unimodular Euclidean lattice work associated with the LAMBDA(F) catalogue entry.
sources.does_not_support: No direct-sum endpoint exclusion or Wave-29 proof signature was found.

sources.type: peer-reviewed journal article and institutional preprint record
sources.title: Über gerade unimodulare Gitter der Dimension 32, III
sources.does_not_support: No K12 direct sum, projector/Schur endpoint, or determinant-log contradiction.

sources.title: On the automorphism group of a putative Conway 99-graph
sources.supports: The publisher abstract explicitly says that existence of an srg(99,14,1,2) remains an elusive open problem, and the article gives automorphism-group restrictions.
sources.does_not_support: It does not claim graph existence/nonexistence and does not contain the searched lattice endpoint result in its inspected metadata.

sources.title: Approaching the Conway-99 problem using SAT solvers
sources.supports: Current primary metadata records SAT experiments and says solvers were incapable of handling the problem in reasonable time.
sources.does_not_support: It does not claim a resolution. Search aggregators that listed a coauthor were disregarded in favor of the primary arXiv author record.

sources.title: The Lower Bound for Number of Hexagons in Strongly Regular Graphs with Parameters lambda=1 and mu=2
sources.supports: The abstract treats existence of srg(99,14,1,2) as a decades-old question and proves a hexagon lower bound for the wider family.
sources.does_not_support: No graph resolution or Wave-29 lattice endpoint theorem.

sources.title: The Subgraphs of Order Six of the Family of Strongly Regular Graphs with Parameters lambda=1 and mu=2
sources.supports: The abstract establishes order-six subgraphs for the parameter family and notes that existence of many family members is uncertain.
sources.does_not_support: No srg(99,14,1,2) resolution or exact lattice exclusion.

sources.title: On Clique Graphs and Clique Regular Graphs
sources.supports: The abstract develops clique-graph methods and applies them to the Conway-99 existence problem among other examples.
sources.does_not_support: No claimed resolution and no match to the endpoint lattice proof signature.

sources.title: Spherical codes and designs
sources.supports: Standard spherical-code and spherical-design framework relevant to graph eigenspace and lattice-shell embeddings.
sources.does_not_support: No exact K12 orthogonal-sum endpoint exclusion.

sources.title: Finite Normalized Tight Frames
sources.does_not_support: No Wave-29 row split, determinant allocation, or final contradiction.

sources.type: preprint exposition of a classical theorem
sources.title: Gauss Sums in Algebra and Topology
sources.supports: An exposition of the Milgram Gauss-sum formula computing the signature modulo 8, which yields the standard rank-divisibility obstruction for positive-definite even unimodular lattices.
sources.does_not_support: It is not a source for the candidate's block allocation or endpoint exclusion.

sources.title: Pseudodeterminants and perfect square spanning tree counts
sources.supports: Standard definition of a pseudodeterminant as the last nonzero characteristic-polynomial coefficient, together with general pseudodeterminant identities.
sources.does_not_support: No exact pointwise log inequality or 729 determinant cap was found.

sources.title: Boris Venkov's Theory of Lattices and Spherical Designs
sources.supports: Authoritative survey of the standard connection between lattice minimal vectors, spherical designs, strong perfection, and extremal even-unimodular lattices.
sources.does_not_support: No exact Wave-29 direct-sum non-realizability result.

sources.title: Non-existence of the strongly regular graph srg(85,14,3,2)
sources.supports: The June 2026 announcement distinguishes the completed srg(85,14,3,2) project from only a possible similar approach to srg(99,14,1,2). This is corroborating current-status metadata, not a theorem source.
sources.does_not_support: It does not prove the Conway-99 target open and contains no Wave-29 lattice result.
